name: The Man of My Dreams
source:
You're at a pool party, trying and failing to make friends, when someone accidentally pushes you off the second floor deck, sending you plummeting. When you come to, you find yourself in the world of your favorite visual novel, Echoes of the Skies. While confused at first, you realize this is the perfect opportunity to try and befriend your favorite character of all time, the fictional love of your life! But he's supposed to be cold, aloof, and really hard to befriend. Why's he already so…clingy?

[From [url=https://omegabutton.itch.io/the-man-of-my-dreams]itch.io[/url]]
